items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Rayburn Wright left New York... [INTERVIEWEE] And he pulled it off.

ctx.x: There must be an out. Part of this has come about because of technology and we're not used to it; technology and music is quite a recent thing.

I guess that's one reason, as we talked before, Rayburn Wright left New York and went up to the Eastman because he wanted to--rather than working with blase in New York he said he'd rather work with less experienced and more enthusiastic people.
